Negative correlation detected between serum ferritin and SIR of the pancreas in our study is similar to Midiri et al. [11] but contradict others [12,13]. Argyropoulou et al [12] explained the lack of correlation between pancreatic siderosis and serum ferritin by the fact that T2 relaxation time depends on both siderosis and fatty infiltration of the pancreas reported in their adult group of patients.
